description: ANThology's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the other consumers.

The preset enables Renovate's git-submodules manager for reports; the shared local driver independently moves the direct hub gitlink to its remote default tip. The preset also pins third-party GitHub Actions by digest while leaving Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure composite actions at @develop for the upstream-first change flow.
docs.yml initializes the recorded ANTfrastructure gitlink for scripts and calls the shared workflows and actions at @develop; push the hub commit before advancing this gitlink.
Dependabot is off family-wide (owner, 2026-10-20): .github/dependabot.yml is deleted, so this file is the only watch over pub too.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH. The Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09) -- no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: the local CLI reads exactly it. See https://github.com/Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure/blob/develop/docs/dependency-updates.md.
